It was a highlight to be in the audience at Config 26 when @figma announced Figma Motion. We've been working directly with Figma, testing our motion system against early builds, helping select and hone which features made the cut, and making sure @Atlassian  design teams could hit the ground running.

You can hear from our own Alexandra Pereira, Davy Fung and Maxwell Hathaway on Figma's release blog. It's a small marker of a positive collaboration that we're really proud of.

Read more at https://t.co/lpP0rgE7Ih

These new toolchain capabilities are already helping up-level moments like animated illustrations, onboarding sequences, and feature announcements in the apps. We're just at the beginning of seeing what motion can do to guide and and celebrate the daily rituals of teamwork.
